MktCalcInsightObjectDef.expression: SELECT Ranked_Account_Revenue__cio.Account_ID__c AS Account_ID__c, MAX(Ranked_Account_Revenue__cio.Account_Revenue__c) AS Account_Revenue__c, MAX(Ranked_Account_Revenue__cio.revenue_rank__c) AS revenue_rank__c, CASE WHEN MAX(Ranked_Account_Revenue__cio.revenue_rank__c) <= 23942 * 0.2 THEN 'Top 20%' ELSE 'Bottom 80%' END AS CI_Account_Revenue_Tier__c FROM Ranked_Account_Revenue__cio GROUP BY Ranked_Account_Revenue__cio.Account_ID__c
